overview.heading: Agricultural education at Career Point University, Kota (School of Agricultural Sciences)
paragraphs: Career Point University, Kota operates its dedicated School of Agricultural Sciences at Kota, Rajasthan, offering B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture, M.Sc. Agriculture (Agronomy). The curriculum follows the 5th Deans’ Committee / ICAR credit structure with core courses in agronomy, genetics and plant breeding, soil science, entomology, plant pathology, horticulture, agricultural economics and extension education.

Applicants can enter the four-year B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture programme through Rajasthan JET / CUET / CPU Merit Counselling. Hadoti region instructional agricultural farm at Alaniya (Kota) supporting soybean, mustard, coriander and citrus cultivation trials alongside soil health and plant pathology laboratories. Candidates comparing private agriculture universities in Rajasthan should verify both state JET counselling seat matrices and cohort-specific statutory accreditation terms before locking their choice.

admissions.heading: Admission process and eligibility at Career Point University, Kota
admissions.intro: Admission to agriculture programmes at Career Point University, Kota is conducted through Rajasthan JET / CUET / CPU Merit Counselling, alongside direct university merit counselling for eligible 10+2 Agriculture/Science candidates.
admissions.route_scope: Both Rajasthan JET state counselling seats and university-level seats require verification of Class XII subject combinations (PCB, PCM, PCA or Agriculture) and original academic certificates at reporting.
eligibility_points: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture: 10+2 in Science (PCB / PCM / Agriculture) from a recognized board with minimum 50% marks.

steps.text: Verify original documents on campus at Kota and obtain the itemised semester/annual fee receipt including hostel and examination heads.

campus.heading: Experimental farms, laboratories and RAWE at Kota
campus.intro: Hadoti region instructional agricultural farm at Alaniya (Kota) supporting soybean, mustard, coriander and citrus cultivation trials alongside soil health and plant pathology laboratories.

facilities.name: Agronomy & Instructional Crop Farm
facilities.description: Field demonstration plots at Kota for kharif and rabi crop trials, seed bed preparation, weed management and micro-irrigation exercises.

facilities.name: Soil Science & Agricultural Chemistry Lab
facilities.description: Equipped for soil pH, electrical conductivity, organic carbon, macronutrient (N-P-K) and micronutrient testing.

facilities.name: Horticulture, Polyhouse & Orchard Unit
facilities.description: Protected cultivation polyhouse/shade-net house, fruit orchard nursery and post-harvest handling practical space.

facilities.name: Plant Pathology, Entomology & Genetics Labs
facilities.description: Compound and stereo microscopy, insect rearing cages, disease specimen collection and seed purity testing equipment.

facilities.name: Student Hostels, Library & Transport
facilities.description: Separate boys and girls residential hostels at Kota, agricultural library journals, mess and city bus connectivity.

practical_learning: Rural Agricultural Work Experience (RAWE) in adopted villages during the final year.
Experiential Learning Programme (ELP) modules in organic inputs, nursery management, Mushroom cultivation and seed production.
Field visits to Krishi Vigyan Kendras (KVKs), state agricultural research stations and agri-input processing plants in Rajasthan.

scholarships.heading: Scholarships and fee concessions at Career Point University, Kota
scholarships.text: Career Point University, Kota offers merit-based tuition scholarships based on Class XII / qualifying examination marks or JET rank, alongside Rajasthan government post-matric scholarships (SJMS / Samaj Kalyan Vibhag) for eligible SC, ST, OBC, MBC and EBC students.

schemes.name: University Entrance & Qualifying Marks Merit Scholarship (2026-27)
schemes.details: Tuition fee waiver slabs (10% to 50% in first year) for applicants scoring 75%+ to 90%+ in 10+2 or high rank in Rajasthan JET / CUET; continuation requires maintaining minimum SGPA and 75% attendance.

schemes.name: Rajasthan State Post-Matric & Girl Child Agriculture Incentive
schemes.details: Eligible Rajasthan domicile students can apply on the Rajasthan SSO Scholarship Portal; girl students in agriculture may also check state Rajshree / Agriculture Department incentive schemes.

placements.heading: Agribusiness career support, internships and higher study
placements.text: The placement and training cell at Career Point University, Kota coordinates final-year agribusiness agro-industrial attachments, KVK internships and preparation for Rajasthan Agriculture Supervisor, AAO, Pre-PG, ICAR JRF and IBPS AFO competitive examinations.
statistics: Graduates pursue roles in seed, fertilizer, crop-protection, micro-irrigation, agri-fintech, warehousing and rural banking sectors, as well as M.Sc. Agriculture through Rajasthan Pre-PG and CUET-PG.
recruiters: Agri-input, seed & crop-care companies across Rajasthan and North India
Agri-warehousing, organic certification & rural banking / microfinance institutions

recognition.heading: Statutory recognition, Rajasthan JET & accreditation scope
recognition.text: Career Point University, Kota is established by an Act of the Rajasthan State Legislature and recognized under Section 2(f) of the UGC Act, 1956. Its School of Agricultural Sciences runs B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture and M.Sc. Agriculture (Agronomy) following the ICAR 5th Deans’ Committee syllabus. Applicants should verify whether their specific cohort requires state Rajasthan JET counselling vs direct ICAR List-II programme accreditation.
